card.name: Methods and confidence-interval wording in data
card.fires_on: The word "using" in instructions for calculating PC20 from methacholine challenge results, and the % sign in "90% CI" headers of pharmacokinetic tables.

modes.label: Calculating with "using"
modes.description: The word "using" introduces a calculation method in lung-function (FEV1, PC20) testing instructions.
modes.example: Calculate PC 20<< using>> one of the following methods: Method #

modes.label: Percent in 90% CI
modes.description: The % sign right after 90 in a drug-interaction table header that gives percent change with a confidence interval.
modes.example: Effect on Coadministered Drug Exposure [% Change (90<<%>> CI)] C max AUC AUC
